title: After dark
steps: It is night in the castle. You cannot sleep. There is a soft knock at the door.
The older pupils say the passages change at night. Dask patrols the halls. He does not want anyone out of bed. Let us go see.
You tiptoe into the dark. Nuri knows the way to the watchtower gallery. Nuri teaches you a new rule of magic. You must look before you step.
We must get past Dask. We must ask a question with a true or false answer. Programmers call this question an expression. Let me show you how.
